description: This Java class is a serializer/deserializer component for handling JSON input related to Teller commands within the Fineract API. It includes validation methods for creating/updating tellers, allocating cashiers, and processing cash transactions, focusing on extracting and validating JSON parameters.

classes.name: TellerCommandFromApiJsonDeserializer
classes.description: A final component class responsible for deserializing and validating JSON payloads for Teller-related API commands in Fineract, including create/update, allocate cashier, and cash transaction validation.

methods.name: validateForCreateAndUpdateTeller
methods.description: Validates JSON input for creating or updating a teller, checking required fields like officeId, name, startDate, and date logic.

methods.name: validateForAllocateCashier
methods.description: Validates JSON input for assigning a cashier to a teller, checking staffId, date range, and time fields if not full day.

methods.name: validateForCashTxnForCashier
methods.description: Validates JSON input for recording a cash transaction for a cashier, focusing on amount, date, note, and currency.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Utility method to throw an exception if validation errors are present.
